card.name: Start of 're' words in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning with 're' (or similar), such as 'Re' in 'Receiving', after 'Patients' or 'Currently' in dosing table titles and headings. Also fires on a few other word starts in drug lists and HIV drug text.
